DRAGON GARDEN

The rainbow dragon is tangling through the crystal flowers — grab your star cannon and guard the garden!

Scan to play on your phone
geemondc.github.io/dragon-garden
How to play
🌸 Drag anywhere — your Star Cannon follows above your finger and auto-fires. Mouse: move + hold. Keys: arrows / WASD + Space.
🐉 Dragon: head 100 · segment 10. Shoot a middle segment and the dragon splits in two!
🌷 Crystal flowers: 4 hits to clear · 1 pt. Damaged flowers regrow between lives (5 pts each).
☄️ Meteor Imp: 200 · takes 2 hits · dives down planting flowers when your zone is nearly bare.
🦊 Shadow Fox: 1,000 · curses flowers purple — a dragon touching one dives straight at you!
🗿 Bouncing Golem: 100 / 300 / 600 by how close it is when you zap it. It eats flowers — and don't let anything touch you!
⭐ Extra guardian at 12,000. Clear the whole dragon to reach the next wave!
